Cloudhal
Docs GitHub npm Playground

Sites your agents can build, safely.

Cloudhal is an open-source site platform. Sites are typed graphs; agents change them through an MCP server behind a policy engine; every change is a snapshot you can diff, preview and roll back. It runs on Cloudflare or on your own machine.

Start

npm create cloudhal@latest my-site
cd my-site
npx cloudhal dev

Then connect your agent: claude mcp add cloudhal -- npx cloudhal mcp --mode edits. Any MCP client works.

Or deploy a blog to your Cloudflare account in one click with the Deploy to Cloudflare button, or try a private site for an hour at try.cloudhal.com.

Reference

  • Docs: guides and architecture decisions (on GitHub until the docs site is ready).
  • JSON Schemas v1: the contracts every Cloudhal implementation shares. Their URLs are permanent.
  • llms.txt: an index of this site for agents.
  • Cloudhal-Fetch: what the fetcher requests from your server, and how to reach us.
Cloudhal is open source under Apache-2.0. Product site: cloudhal.com. Security: security@cloudhal.com.
